WITH supplier_rates AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_name,
        -- on‑time rate for Jan‑Apr 2026
        SUM(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30')
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30'), 0) AS rate_jan_apr,
        -- on‑time rate for May‑Oct 2026
        SUM(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-10-31')
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-10-31'), 0) AS rate_may_oct
    FROM v_purchasing
    WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL
      AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'
    GROUP BY supplier_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30') > 0
       AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-10-31') > 0
), rate_diff AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_name,
        rate_jan_apr,
        rate_may_oct,
        (rate_may_oct - rate_jan_apr) AS rate_change
    FROM supplier_rates
)
SELECT
    supplier_name,
    round(rate_jan_apr::numeric, 4) AS rate_jan_apr,
    round(rate_may_oct::numeric, 4) AS rate_may_oct,
    round(rate_change::numeric, 4) AS drop_rate
FROM rate_diff
ORDER BY drop_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH month_rev AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(revenue) AS rev
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
      AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
      AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)
)
SELECT round(((oct.rev - sep.rev) / NULLIF(sep.rev, 0)) * 100::numeric, 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM month_rev sep
JOIN month_rev oct ON oct.month = DATE '2026-10-01'
WHERE sep.month = DATE '2026-09-01'

SELECT category,
       round( (SUM(margin)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0)) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales

WITH revenue_by_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(revenue) AS rev
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           rev,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rn
    FROM revenue_by_customer
), top10 AS (
    SELECT SUM(rev) AS top_rev
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 10
), total AS (
    SELECT SUM(rev) AS total_rev
    FROM revenue_by_customer
)
SELECT round((top10.top_rev / total.total_rev) * 100::numeric, 2) AS top_10_customer_pct
FROM top10, total

WITH rev_q AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)::date AS quarter_start,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'  -- start of Q2
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'   -- end of Q3 start
  GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_lower_rev
FROM (
  SELECT
    q2.customer_id,
    q2.revenue AS rev_q2,
    q3.revenue AS rev_q3
  FROM rev_q q2
  JOIN rev_q q3 ON q2.customer_id = q3.customer_id
  WHERE q2.quarter_start = DATE '2026-04-01'  -- Q2 start
    AND q3.quarter_start = DATE '2026-07-01'  -- Q3 start
    AND q2.revenue > 0
    AND q3.revenue < q2.revenue
) sub;

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'nov_dec_2025'
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' THEN 'jul_aug_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
       OR order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  round((
    COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM rev WHERE period = 'nov_dec_2025'), 0) -
    COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM rev WHERE period = 'jul_aug_2026'), 0)
  )::numeric, 2) AS revenue_diff

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)::date AS quarter_start,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' -- start of Q2 2026
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'   -- end of Q3 2026
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)
), pivot AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_start = DATE '2026-04-01' THEN rev END) AS rev_q2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_start = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN rev END) AS rev_q3
  FROM rev p
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  round(coalesce(rev_q3,0) - coalesce(rev_q2,0), 2) AS rev_growth
FROM pivot
WHERE coalesce(rev_q3,0) - coalesce(rev_q2,0) = (
  SELECT MAX(coalesce(rev_q3,0) - coalesce(rev_q2,0))
  FROM pivot
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT round(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN days_late > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS pct_late
FROM v_purchasing
WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       round( (SUM(s.margin) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0)) * 100::numeric, 2) AS margin_pct,
       SUM(s.qty) AS units_sold,
       round(SUM(s.revenue)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue,
       round(SUM(s.margin)::numeric, 2) AS total_margin
FROM v_sales s
JOIN v_products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(s.qty) >= 100
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
